events.title: Shanghai AI Lab opens Sage S2.1 Flash for scientific and agent tasks
events.title_zh: 上海 AI Lab 开放 Sage S2.1 Flash 权重
events.summary_en: Shanghai AI Laboratory released MIT-licensed weights for Sage S2.1 Flash, a 321B-parameter model for scientific inputs, coding, research and tool use. Optional projectors map more than ten scientific data types, including molecules, crystals and proteins, into the model input space. The publisher reports competitive results across coding, office and agent benchmarks; no independent reproduction was verified.
events.summary_zh: 上海 AI Lab 发布 Sage S2.1 Flash 的 MIT 许可权重。它是 321B 参数模型，面向科学输入、coding、research 与工具使用；可选 projector 能把分子、晶体、蛋白质等十多种科学数据映射到模型输入空间。发布方报告它在 coding、办公和 agent benchmark 上具有竞争力，本次未核实到独立复现。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams building scientific agents can now test one open model across structured scientific inputs and general tool workflows. The large self-hosting footprint, separate projector setup and publisher-run benchmarks keep it at TRIAL rather than ADOPT.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 构建科研 agent 的团队现在可以用一个开放模型同时测试结构化科学输入和通用工具流程。模型体量大、projector 需单独配置，benchmark 又来自发布方，因此只适合 TRIAL。

technical_details.license: MIT for code and model weights
technical_details.scientific_inputs: More than ten types through Sage SciPerception projectors, including molecular graphs, crystal structures and protein sequences and 3D structures
technical_details.availability: Public BF16 and FP8 repositories; no inference provider listed at check time
technical_details.publisher_evaluation: First on 4 and second on 7 of the highlighted benchmarks across six compared models
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher-run evaluation; 337 downloads last month at check time; no independent reproduction verified
technical_details.time_basis: Hugging Face repository created 2026-11-15T02:34:59Z; discovered through recall audit.

technical_details_zh.许可: 代码与模型权重均为 MIT
technical_details_zh.科学输入: 通过 Sage SciPerception projector 支持十多种类型，包括分子图、晶体结构、蛋白质序列和 3D 结构
technical_details_zh.可用性: 公开 BF16 与 FP8 仓库；核验时没有 Inference Provider
technical_details_zh.发布方评测: 与 6 个模型对比的重点 benchmark 中，4 项第一、7 项第二
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方自行评测；核验时近月下载 337 次；未核实独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Hugging Face 仓库创建于 2026-11-15T02:34:59Z，由召回自检发现。

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开权重或 FP8 版本跑 10 个 coding 与科学输入样例，核对 projector 配置、显存、质量和延迟。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run 10 coding and scientific-input cases on the public weights or FP8 build and check projector setup, memory, quality and latency.

Optional projectors map more than ten scientific data types, including molecules, crystals and proteins, into the model input space. The publisher reports competitive results across coding, office and agent benchmarks; no independent reproduction was verified.
events.why_it_matters: Teams building scientific agents can now test one open model across structured scientific inputs and general tool workflows. The large self-hosting footprint, separate projector setup and publisher-run benchmarks keep it at TRIAL rather than ADOPT.

evidence.claim_zh: 官方 Hugging Face model card 确认 MIT 权重、科学 projector、部署路径与发布方评测。
evidence.claim_en: The official Hugging Face model card confirms MIT weights, scientific projectors, deployment paths and publisher-run evaluations.

events.title: BIS moves chip controls toward remote access to overseas compute
events.title_zh: BIS 将先进芯片管制延伸到海外算力远程访问
organization: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security
events.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security published its interim final rule on remote access to advanced compute in the Federal Register. It took effect on November 19, 2026, with comments due January 19, 2027. Existing covered data centers have 90 days to obtain a license.
events.summary_en: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security published its interim final rule on remote access to advanced compute in the Federal Register. It took effect on November 19, 2026, with comments due January 19, 2027. Existing covered data centers have 90 days to obtain a license.
events.summary_zh: 美国商务部 BIS 已在《联邦公报》刊登先进算力远程访问 interim final rule。规则于 2026 年 11 月 19 日生效，意见征集截至 2027 年 1 月 19 日；已有受管数据中心有 90 天取得许可证。
events.why_it_matters: Cloud, model-hosting and chip-supply teams now have an effective compliance date rather than a placeholder. Remote access can trigger export-control duties even when no chip crosses a border.
events.why_it_matters_en: Cloud, model-hosting and chip-supply teams now have an effective compliance date rather than a placeholder. Remote access can trigger export-control duties even when no chip crosses a border.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对云服务、模型托管和芯片供应团队来说，规则已从日期占位符变成正式生效义务。即使芯片没有跨境，远程算力访问也可能触发出口管制。

technical_details.legal_stage: Interim final rule published in the Federal Register; effective November 19, 2026
technical_details.remote_access_scope: License requirement for significant compute supplied to entities headquartered or parented in Macau or Country Group D:5
technical_details.destination_scope: Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brazil and Thailand; U.S.-headquartered end users may qualify for exclusions with reporting
technical_details.transition: Existing covered data centers would have 90 days from the effective date to obtain a license
technical_details.exemption: Commercial recommender systems as narrowly defined; generative systems are excluded from that definition
technical_details.evidence_limit: Federal Register publication and dates verified

technical_details_zh.法律阶段: interim final rule 已刊登《联邦公报》，2026-11-19 生效
technical_details_zh.远程访问范围: 向总部或最终母公司位于澳门或 Country Group D:5 的实体提供大量算力时触发许可证要求
technical_details_zh.目的地范围: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡、巴西、泰国；美国总部终端用户在满足报告要求时可能适用排除
technical_details_zh.过渡期: 已有受管数据中心拟在生效日起 90 天内取得许可证
technical_details_zh.豁免: 狭义 commercial recommender system；生成式系统不在该定义内
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 已核对《联邦公报》刊登与日期

events.next_action_zh: 立即映射受影响的数据中心、客户总部、算力阈值和报告责任，并在 90 天过渡期内准备许可证。
events.next_action_en: Immediately map affected data centers, customer headquarters, compute thresholds and reporting duties, and prepare licenses within the 90-day transition.

evidence.claim_zh: BIS 已发布预发布 IFR 文本，把部分先进算力远程访问纳入许可证要求；生效日期仍待《联邦公报》刊登。
evidence.claim_en: BIS published prepublication IFR text that brings some remote access to advanced compute under licensing; the effective date awaits Federal Register publication.
The Federal Register confirms the rule took effect on November 19, 2026, with comments due January 19, 2027.

changes.summary_zh: BIS 发布远程算力访问管制的预发布 IFR 文本
changes.summary_en: BIS publishes prepublication IFR text for remote compute access controls

changes.summary_zh: BIS 远程算力规则正式刊登并生效
changes.summary_en: The BIS remote-compute rule is formally published and effective
